name: Roasted Sole with Honey Lemon Broccoli & Almond-Raisin Couscous Pilaf
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and grate carrots; place in a medium saucepan.
Add broth to the pan with the carrot, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once boiling, remove broth from the heat, add couscous and garlic powder, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.

Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet on lower rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until broccoli is lightly charred and fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the broccoli is roasting, place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine.
Pat the fish dry with paper towels and place on another baking sheet; season with spice mix on both sides and drizzle with oil. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet on upper rack of the oven and roast fish until flakey and cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into the reserved bowl; add honey and oil. Whisk to combine the honey-lemon sauce.
When the broccoli is done, drizzle the honey-lemon sauce over top and toss to coat.
Fluff couscous with a fork, then add almonds and raisins; gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide fish, couscous, and broccoli between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
